integrity: Exact proof uses uniform rooted forests, a reduced-Laplacian determinant, and Pascal-network minors. The accompanying standalone checker passed 91,703 exact assertions; no independent external validation or priority certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the uniform labeled Cayley-tree law with three fixed distinct vertices is proved. The conditional enumeration follows from earlier general marked-subtree/forest formulas; the claimed structural contribution is the all-order Pascal survival-kernel minor law and the strict conditional likelihood-ratio ordering. Earlier implicit statements of these inequalities remain a priority risk.
title: Pascal total positivity for three-point geodesic depth in uniform Cayley trees
